label: Sample data. Fictional company, names and documents.

metric_definitions.durations: step_executions is the raw ordered visit list; duration_s is positive integer seconds per visit; step_durations_s sums visits per step per run
metric_definitions.visits: execution_n and visit_n are ordinals; rework_step_order and loop_step_ns are step references; repeated work is counted once via its own visit
metric_definitions.bottleneck_trace: Bottleneck action offsets are cumulative active seconds across visits to that step, not wall-clock run offsets
metric_definitions.verdicts: Long verdict quotes marginal step median and total run median separately, rounded to tenths of minutes; card times use the same step median and the rework card uses share of newcomer runs with repeated work
metric_definitions.actions: Offsets and durations in seconds. Step illustrations span executed-run medians; variant traces span the referenced example run. All fictional.
metric_definitions.nested_events: reminder_events and while_waiting_events offsets are seconds from initial reply-wait start; durations are seconds per event
metric_definitions.identifiers: schema_version and n are ordinals; step_n, source_step_n and step_order reference steps; identifiers and the seed are not measurements
metric_definitions.tenure: tenure_months: completed months per fictional person at window start
metric_definitions.volume: runs_per_week and requests_per_week: completed sample runs divided by calendar weeks in the window
metric_definitions.step_share_explanation: Normalize cohort step medians to an additive typical profile. This denominator is not median total elapsed run time; do not relabel it as such.
metric_definitions.optional_steps: Absent executed-step keys contribute zero to cohort median and p90 only; conditional executed-run statistics are separate
metric_definitions.display_shares: Largest-remainder rounding to tenths of a percent so each displayed distribution sums exactly
metric_definitions.mean: Arithmetic mean of raw observations; exported fractional summaries rounded to micro-units
metric_definitions.takeover: assumed_takeover_share: scenario fraction of active bottleneck seconds only; wait and unobserved gaps are ineligible
metric_definitions.labor: Active work plus nested reminder durations. Wait minus nested reminders is nonwork elapsed gap, not idle labor; unrelated-task time is not charged to this request.
metric_definitions.scope: Completed samples only; no claim of population representativeness or causation

recommendation.title: Structure the adjuster request and reminder queue
recommendation.what: Draft a request with the claim link, missing instruction and required response fields; route it to the assigned adjuster and send policy-approved reminders without duplicating threads.
recommendation.trigger: Correspondence cannot proceed because an administrative adjuster instruction is missing
outputs: Reply linked to the pending task
recommendation.assumption_scope: Fraction of active bottleneck-step time only; hypothetical, not measured and never applied to elapsed waiting
acceptance: Create one request thread per pending task and missing instruction; retries must not duplicate requests
Use an approved reminder cadence and staffed-time rules; stop reminders when a linked reply arrives
Route missing response fields to clarification and unresolved requests to the named escalation owner
Require review before sending; log request, reminder and reply references without making coverage decisions

extra.domain_review: Review reminder cadence, ownership and whether some instructions could be read directly under existing permissions. Reply intervals include overnight and weekend time; elapsed waiting is not idle paid time. Weekday staffing, clarification and reminder frequencies are assumed. The completed-only window intentionally caps the last sampled reply and is not an unbiased service-level estimate.
extra.boundary: One request from sending preparation through task release. Adjuster work is outside this team view. First-reply wait includes nested reminders and unrelated tasks; clarification wait ends when the answer is reopened.
extra.sampling_scope: Completed fictional cases in the stated calendar window; weekly volume is observed sample count divided by window weeks, not enterprise demand
extra.causal_limit: Case mix and familiarity are deliberately modeled; timing differences do not establish causation or rank real employees
extra.wait_semantics: Initial and clarification reply intervals are elapsed calendar seconds; resume delay is separate. Reminders are nested work within the initial wait. Context-switch events describe unrelated work, not additional request time.
extra.staffing_assumption: Weekdays in the UTC afternoon and evening; reminder and unrelated-work events stay within the staffed interval, while passive reply waits may cross nights and weekends. This is not a full personal shift schedule.

cases.title: Exception handling: expert versus newcomer

bottleneck.why: Drafting before term and authority checks creates a discard-and-redraft loop; repeated visits, not archive retrieval, consume the time.

evidence.source: runs[*].step_executions; sum visit duration_s by step_n

recommendation.title: Put authority and term checks before drafting
recommendation.what: Require the affected term and requester authority to be confirmed before opening a correction draft; surface source fields and a trainer-reviewed expert procedure, with human approval before any live change.
recommendation.trigger: A correspondence exception is classified as a mailing-address mismatch
outputs: Referral if risk location or authority is unclear
manual_touchpoints: Review the procedure before training use
recommendation.assumption_scope: Fraction of active bottleneck-step time only; hypothetical, not measured and never applied to elapsed waiting
acceptance: Block correction drafting until affected term and requester authority have been confirmed
Refer risk-location changes and unsupported instructions instead of proposing mailing-only edits
Link every draft mailing field to its signed source; require human approval before live writeback
Test term mismatch and authority mismatch paths; retain discarded-draft history and trainer sign-off on the procedure

extra.domain_review: Confirm actual document counts, index fields, duplicate rules and archive acknowledgment behavior. The sample contains repair estimates and property evidence, not medical records; permission and retention review is still required. The modeled entry time includes cross-checking, not typing alone.
extra.boundary: A run is an inbox package of related documents for an already-established property claim, not claim creation. Packages with an unresolved claim match are excluded and would need a separate exception queue.
extra.sampling_scope: Completed fictional cases in the stated calendar window; weekly volume is observed sample count divided by window weeks, not enterprise demand
extra.causal_limit: Case mix and familiarity are deliberately modeled; timing differences do not establish causation or rank real employees
